Overview

Curitiba is a city in PR with a population of 1,963,726. Brazil’s greenest city and a global model for urban planning, famous for its BRT system, parks, and high environmental standards. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
